name: Settings render variant thumbnail picker
purpose: 在设置窗口中用缩略图卡片选择各窗口 RenderVariant 枚举，替代普通下拉并保持实时预览。
lifecycle: settings window lifetime; sample images are loaded lazily only when owner != null
reuse: 新增可生效的窗口外观枚举应复用 VariantPicker；控件必须支持无 PNG 时纯文字降级，且不得在 RunSettingsBindingSelfTest 的 owner == null 路径渲染真实窗口样例。

name: Settings render variant sample cache
purpose: 缓存设置窗口 VariantPicker 使用的各窗口外观缩略图 PNG。
lifecycle: generated on first opening a settings page with a missing picker sample; versioned cache directory changes with ProductIdentity.Version
reuse: 缩略图缺失或生成失败不能阻塞设置窗口；版本升级后写入新的 v<version> 目录，旧目录可由用户或维护任务清理。

name: Codex Radar hidden-mode chrome suppression
purpose: 在防烧屏隐藏反色激活时跳过 Codex/Claude 软件族彩色内边框，避免反相后的黄橙边框被误读为告警状态或残留彩色轮廓。
protocol: in-process GDI+ draw guard before BurnInProtection bitmap color pass
outputs: ordinary mode draws blue/orange software family inner border
hidden color-protection mode draws no software family inner border
lifecycle: evaluated on each CodexRadar repaint; scene cache key already includes burn-in color-protection state
reuse: 不要在 BurnInProtection.ApplyHiddenModeColorProtection 后做黄橙像素级清理；蓝色 Codex chrome 会在反色后变黄橙，必须在 DrawCodexRadarSoftwareInnerBorder 绘制前以隐藏态判断抑制。其它彩色业务内容继续由现有反色规则处理。

name: WidgetSettings user default snapshot
purpose: Applies the user-confirmed settings.ini profile as the product default values created by WidgetSettings.CreateDefaults.
protocol: in-process C# helper invoked before Normalize; generated from a backed-up UTF-8 key=value settings.ini snapshot
lifecycle: called whenever defaults are constructed for missing or legacy settings
reuse: Only update this helper after backing up %LOCALAPPDATA%/DesktopCodexAssistant/settings.ini. Do not promote runtime one-shot counters such as *RefreshToken, *ServiceProbeToken or DeepSeekApiKeyRevision into nonzero defaults.

name: RenderSampleSupport composited current-sample writer
purpose: 渲染采样 current 模式共享助手：把窗口完整 Draw*Window 输出画入透明 ARGB 层，按整窗 alpha 合成到深色壁纸替身底色后保存 PNG，使采样图接近屏幕真实观感。仅测试通道使用，不属于运行时路径。
lifecycle: invoked by --render-* commands only
reuse: 新增窗口的 current 采样必须复用本助手，禁止在各窗口 RenderSample 里手写合成。
